kind: local experiment follow-up; no published release changed

artifact.cause: Signed view cosine on back-facing overlapping water slopes was clamped to zero, forcing 100% sky Fresnel reflection.
artifact.fix: Use the absolute view cosine for the two-sided enhanced water surface.
artifact.scope: Same shared shader in Off, Mirror and Ray traced (test); original water material unchanged.

method: Frozen gz3g scene and camera, other optional graphics off except enhanced water and sky; main-view AA and shadows off.
Three interleaved rounds, 35 settling frames and 90 wall-time samples per case; FPS limit and vsync disabled.
Mirror default: 1280x720, 2x MSAA; RT: 640x360, one ray per pixel.
Mirror GPU and CPU times use RenderingServer per-viewport measurements. RT GPU timestamps bracket the render-thread commands submitted by WaterReflection (process priorities 99/100/101).
GPU ranges are min/max of the three per-round medians. Whole-frame aggregate is the median of the three per-round medians.

Matched Mirror is a diagnostic 640x360, no-MSAA draw. Its already-positioned controller is paused to prevent full/half resizes each frame; use its GPU timing only, not its wall time, as a normal-mode comparison.
limits: Shared development machine with concurrent GPU/CPU activity; not an isolated performance qualification.
RT uses simpler static-geometry shading, with no animated units or reflected shadows; not equal visual quality.
RT preparation took 3.478-5.371 seconds from selection in this run. Mirror remains active while the snapshot is prepared.
The earlier diagnostic run produced about 24 FPS in both normal modes; the final run produced about 18 FPS in both. Overall FPS differences are not reliable evidence of a speedup.
The earlier repeatedly resized half-Mirror diagnostic was superseded by this stable-target run.
The second NVIDIA GPU could not present to the private Xvfb display; all accepted measurements use GPU 0.

result: 19 rendered regression checks passed; all 12 benchmark cases completed; no script/shader/runtime errors.
